title: Pollen tiers move to D1
summary:
Pollen tiers gained daily D1 refills and clearer balance accounting, while yesterday’s releases made their way into the news.

Team work moved tier balances out of Polar. New accounts start on Spore with 1 Pollen, and tier balances refill daily at 00:00 UTC without rollover; Router receives 500 Pollen per refill.

Requests now draw from tier balance first, then crypto, then pack balance. Enter adds a tier balance section with hover breakdowns. Tier changes appear after a page refresh, with the new balance applying at the next refill unless updated separately. The changed checkout flow returns 503 for Polar pack purchases; the customer portal remains available.

Agent-maintained highlights and README news now cover Wan 2.6, Klein Large, the Vercel AI SDK provider, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. These are news-list updates, not new model or SDK changes today.
